issues.issue: The first runner attempt compared historical v2 CPU-reconstructed test probabilities against authoritative v1 GPU-stored probabilities using an unnecessary 1e-7 gate.
issues.resolution: Use already-materialized historical reconstruction scores only for validation and authoritative v1 per-pair scores for P1 held-out evaluation, exactly as frozen. No R3 checkpoint inference was performed.

issues.issue: The second runner attempt checked frozen P3 probabilities against v1 GPU-stored values although historical V3 was built from the audited v2 CPU reconstruction.
issues.resolution: Verify P3 score provenance and decisions against the immutable historical V3 input reconstruction. P3 decisions and historical thresholds were not changed.

issues.issue: An initial draft summary pooled fold-specific P0 prevalence constants into an invalid cross-fold ranking.
issues.resolution: Remove cross-fold P0 discrimination ranking. Report each rotation/source tied-score point with AUPRC equal to held-out prevalence and tie-aware AUROC 0.5. Calibration remains cross-validated prediction assessment.

issues.issue: A draft P0 prevalence table emitted one source=ALL row for the source-wise reference even though no single source-wise constant exists for that mixed row.
issues.resolution: Retain pooled and three individual source strata, and omit the scientifically undefined mixed source-wise constant row.
